dataset_evidence: 18,988 same-day all-cause counts contain respiratory visits; share uses the outcome
mitigation: Use only calendar and exact lag for demonstration; retain contemporaneous columns only for EDA and audit

dataset_evidence: 18,790 available lag links are exactly 7 days earlier; one-to-one keys
potential_consequence: Future information could inflate apparent performance
mitigation: Exact-date merge and executable lag assertions; no backward fill

dataset_evidence: Annual snapshots have event dates but no publication/revision timestamps
potential_consequence: Even an event-time lag might not have been known at decision time
mitigation: Do not deploy; obtain release history and enforce as-of joins

dataset_evidence: Duplicate source keys = 0; all three split pairs have 0 common dates and hospital-day keys
potential_consequence: Related observations could appear on both sides
mitigation: Pair causes first; assign every hospital on a date to the same time block

dataset_evidence: 26 hospitals repeat across periods; no patient identifier exists
potential_consequence: Random rows could overstate transfer to new hospitals or independent people
mitigation: Chronological known-hospital scope; no new-hospital or patient-level claims

dataset_evidence: Median 11.0000, mean 19.4204, SD 23.9666 fitted on 9,487 2023 rows only
mitigation: Frozen parameters applied to later subsets; never impute outcomes

dataset_evidence: C1 historical panel requires complete 2023 AND 2024 calendars
potential_consequence: Future reporting could choose the training population
mitigation: Use 2023-observed 26-hospital universe for validation; panel only for historical continuity

dataset_evidence: No external clinical or outcome table is joined; dictionary only maps cause definitions

mitigation: Names excluded from feature set; ID/date lag merge validates one-to-one cardinality
